name: Eve
source:
A friend of [url=http://vndb.org/c1471]Yuki[/url]'s, Eve had been searching for her when she encountered [url=http://vndb.org/c1474]Haruki[/url], who happened to know where Yuki was. She forced [url=http://vndb.org/c1472]Suzu[/url] to let her stay at her house. Why was she looking for Yuki?

[translated from [url=http://stylezero.yukishigure.com/snowrain2/chara5.html]official site[/url]]
